summary: Read or replace the full serialized URL through href.

semantics.setter: USVString-convert then parse as an absolute URL and replace components
semantics.setter_failure: throws TypeError and does not partially replace the URL

tests.name: href setter canonicalizes
tests.input: const u=new URL("https://a.example/"); u.href="https://B.example:443/x y"; console.log(u.href);
